summary: wxwxtt ships install-time beacon exfiltrating host/system information
details: The package ships beacon.cjs which, using the http/https and os modules, collects host and process information (including os module data, process.cwd(), process.version) and sends it to a remote endpoint. The package has no legitimate functionality that would justify this reconnaissance beacon, and the beacon shape (sysinfo gathering + outbound HTTP) matches installer-side host reconnaissance against the machine running `npm install` or requiring the module. There is no documented purpose that would justify collecting and transmitting host identifiers from a package of this name and scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
